## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Installation — Docs Page

**Figma frame:** _Installation — Docs Page_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Documentation page layout with title/subtitle, hero image, requirements, and install commands block.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Documentation title, subtitle, and hero-image layout.
- Requirements content and command-block anatomy, including copy affordance states.
- Narrow reading layout and mobile responsive behavior.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile installation documentation frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Title, subtitle, hero image, requirements, and install commands are represented
- [ ] Command blocks are readable, selectable, and have documented copy states
- [ ] Documentation reading width and responsive layout follow UI-20 rules
- [ ] Uses UI-17 dark-mode tokens and UI-19 components where applicable
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
